# AnimusLab

> Independent research and engineering institution focused on reasoning, governance, and observability infrastructure for intelligent systems.

## Founder & Stewardship
- Founding Steward: Tanishq Dasari (https://github.com/Tanishq1030)

## Core Programs
- **Anchor** — Deterministic runtime governance & auditability layer (https://anchor.animuslab.dev)
- **ANIMUS** — Neuro-symbolic reasoning kernel (https://www.animuslab.dev/programs)
- **Shadow Watch** — Behavioral verification & institutional accountability (https://www.animuslab.dev/programs)
